verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents local development for Functions ('Develop locally, deploy when ready') and a Docker-based self-hosted install. One community user notes the containerized setup makes development and testing easier. Sites also gives non-production branches preview links. Together these allow testing away from production, but there is no documented first-party sandbox or test-environment feature that isolates data from production. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/staging environment or project-branching feature, documented isolation of test data from production data, and agent-specific (MCP/CLI) targeting of a sandbox.
